body: Blur on top menu does not work sometimes If I load to many links networks, the blue on top menu starts blinking, yet if few links networks are loaded top menu blur stays solid. Also share button is not aligned, and takes a lot of space, I think we can remove this share button, as clicking to the links network itself already goes to the editor with option to share. We also should double check for all other places where we might have something missaligned in html UI elements like this. Also previously we fixed the bend/alignment of defaults at https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/issues/21 But here we still have default 20%, which makes straight links wobbly. We should find a way to resolve this contradiction, and allow both closed (fully or partially) and unclosed (straight) links look perfectly by default. Also the bend default should be something like 0%, yet may be we have some separate setting for closed (fully or partially links). And default for bend or twist or rotation of all links should be 0%, and minimum and maximum -90% and 90%, maybe even +-180%. We should double check for all other settings we provide wide range of configuration. For the bar/arrow offsets on for both ends of links we should make sure offset follows the curvature of a link line, as the line may be curved, and bar/arrow may not follow the curvature, meaning it sometimes straight, yet should be rotated to match/follow the line. We should double check we exactly double check and care about all the smallest details, and check that by default everything looks aligned, perfect and correct (tested) As at the moment this is the most precise editor for correct according to links theory visualizations of links, we need to make sure everything small detail is absolutely perfect. So I think https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/issues/21 was not fully addressed (double check other requirements). Also we need to be able to configure gap to the center of the link and start/end not only for all links, but for each link separately as in addition to angle configuration it may allow to reduce links overlapping each other when the layout is complex. We should also add auto-adjusting of this setting at experimental feature where we reduce overlapping of links. We need to download all logs and data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), in which we will reconstruct timeline/sequence of events, list of each and all requirements from the issue, find root causes of the each problem, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions). If there is not enough data to find actual root cause, add debug output and verbose mode if not present, that will allow us to find root cause on next iteration. If issue related to any other repository/project, where we can report issues on GitHub, please do so. Each issue must contain reproducible examples, workarounds and suggestions for fix the issue in code. Also double check to fully apply requirements to entire codebase, so if we have issue in multiple places, it should be fixed in all them. Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until it is each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: UI/UX fixes and improvements
